notes.title: v1.1.0 Hotfix
notes.notes:
Patch Notes
Summary

 Better achievement sync for demo progress, less menu clashing.

Bug Fixes

 Fixed an issue where players who played the demo could not unlock the "Now You Can Spend Those Red Things" and "Don't Worry, He's Trustworthy" achievements.
 Updated menu processing so that instances where the game over and level up menus would overlap occur less frequently(and hopefully not at all anymore).

notes.title: v1.1.0 Patch
notes.notes:
Patch Notes

Summary

Made quest grinding less tedious, streamlined the Buddy Shop experience, and fixed broken survivor abilities.

Quests
Changes

 Rebalanced quest rewards to favor higher payouts. Quests should now pay more appropriately depending on the time limit and objective.

Buddy Shop
Changes

 Menu layout of the Buddy Shop has been updated to create a more streamlined experience.
 Removed the Buddy Loadout toggle due to the process not being well designed.
 Unlocking characters in the Buddy Shop now automatically applies changes made.
 Increased HP cost from 2000 to 5000.
 Increased SPD cost from 2000 to 5000.
 Added refund options for HP and SPD purchases.
 Changed icons for ability and weapon purchase buttons to reflect a more general appearance.

Bug Fixes

 Fixed a bug that would allow players to purchase a survivor’s ability even when the ability was already unlocked.

Combat
Balancing

 Increased Hunter’s ability duration from 10 to 15 seconds.
 Increased Robot’s ability duration from 10 to 15 seconds.
 Decreased Valkyrie’s ability recharge from 15 to 10 seconds.
 Increased Valkyrie’s ability duration from 10 to 15 seconds.
 Increased Witchy’s ability duration from 5 to 7 seconds.
 Increased Witchy’s ability recharge from 5 to 7 seconds.

Changes

 Added an aura to Dragon’s ability that deals burn damage to enemies that get too close.

Bug Fixes

 Fixed a bug relating to Super Weapon cooldowns not starting at the correct time.
 Fixed the Zap Sword recharge and duration values being incorrect when picked up by players.

QoL
Changes

 Renamed Super Weapon Shop to Super Weapon Recipe Shop to reflect purpose more clearly.
 Added required weapon levels to super weapon recipe screens for better clarification.
 Added keyboard shortcuts to character select screen for changing character costumes.
 Added controller button layout section to Options screen.
 Added opacity settings for player projectiles, dropped items, and HUD.

Audio
Changes

 Added limiters to combat sound sources so that players’ ears will hopefully not get blown out.

Bug Fixes

 Fixed a bug that would occur in the character select screen where highlighting an unlocked character would cause the menu sound to play twice.

Misc
Changes

 Added an achievement sync check for players continuing from demo data.
 Added better credits in the Credits screen.
 Added Delete Local Achievements button to the Data tab in the Options screen.
 Added Delete Steam Achievements button to the Data tab in the Options screen.
 Added money abbreviations to save space where player money values are displayed when displaying large numbers.

Dev Notes
So many small things stacked up and definitely needed to be addressed. Thank you all for the feedback! I hope these changes make for a better experience as a smol survivor and game.

smolblockboi

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.notes:
Heylo y'all,

Releasing a demo for people to play has been a big thing for me. I feel I really dropped the ball with the initial reveal so I've been hard at work to bring it up to a more appropriate level.

What's new:

New area: Volatile Volcano. This area has some new enemies that have both explosive and fiery personalities. Comes with it's own new boss as well.
Bosses updated. Bosses now have triggers associated with things like damage taken and can enter a second phase that changes how they behave. They also drop an item called Magnet that will allow players to quickly gather scattered exp and coins.
Quests. Quests can be accessed from the new Quest Board once unlocked and are a great way to make some extra gold. Rescue quests are now the primary method of unlocking NPC facilities. The other two quests are called Defender and Exterminator.
NPC Facilities. Specific NPCs now offer services once brought back to camp via Rescue quests. There are currently two available as of this update.
Badge System. Brand new feature. Allows equipping up to four different badges that modify various aspects of combat such as granting a revive, increasing speed, and even doubling exp.
Dash Ability. Brand new feature. Performs an intangible dash through enemies in case players get surrounded.
UI update. The menus have gotten a bit of a glow-up and streamlined. This includes a new responsive input method that currently supports keyboard, mouse, and Xbox controller layouts.


Thank you for reading and to everyone who's been supporting me with this game.
